info.name: MessageBird Balance Available Numbers Messages API

params.name: conversationId
params.description: The unique identifier of the conversation.

params.name: offset
params.description: The number of items to skip.

params.name: limit
params.description: The maximum number of items to return.

items.docs: Retrieves a paginated list of all messages within a specific conversation. Messages are returned with the newest first.

info.name: Send a message in a conversation

params.name: conversationId
params.description: The unique identifier of the conversation.

items.docs: Sends a new message within an existing conversation. The message will be delivered through the channel associated with the conversation.
Sends a message to a recipient without requiring an existing conversation. MessageBird will automatically match or create a conversation for the recipient.

params.name: messageId
params.description: The unique identifier of the message.

items.docs: Retrieves the details of a specific message by its unique identifier.

params.name: offset
params.description: The number of items to skip before starting to collect the result set.

params.name: limit
params.description: The maximum number of items to return.

items.docs: Retrieves a list of SMS messages that have been sent or received. Messages are returned in reverse chronological order.

Creates a new SMS message and sends it to the specified recipients. A single message can be sent to up to 50 recipients at a time. Messages longer than 160 characters are automatically split into multiple parts.

params.name: id
params.description: The unique identifier of the message.

items.docs: Retrieves the information of an existing inbound or outbound SMS message. You only need to supply the unique message ID that was returned upon creation or receiving.

params.name: id
params.description: The unique identifier of the message.

items.docs: Deletes an existing message. You only need to supply the unique message ID that was returned upon creation.
